+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Parameter
+from .decorators import FC
+from .decorators import option
+
+
+def confirm_option(*param_decls: str, **kwargs: t.Any) -> t.Callable[[FC], FC]:
+    """Add a ``--confirm`` option which shows a prompt before continuing
+    if not passed. If the prompt is declined, the program will exit.
+
+    This works like :func:`~click.confirmation_option`, but defaults to
+    ``--confirm`` instead of ``--yes``.
+
+    :param param_decls: One or more option names. Defaults to the single
+        value ``"--confirm"``.
+    :param kwargs: Extra arguments are passed to :func:`option`.
+    """
+
+    def callback(ctx: Context, param: Parameter, value: bool) -> None:
+        if not value:
+            ctx.abort()
+
+    if not param_decls:
+        param_decls = ("--confirm",)
+
+    kwargs.setdefault("is_flag", True)
+    kwargs.setdefault("callback", callback)
+    kwargs.setdefault("expose_value", False)
+    kwargs.setdefault("prompt", "Do you want to continue?")
+    kwargs.setdefault("help", "Confirm the action without prompting.")
+    return option(*param_decls, **kwargs)

+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.confirm_option import confirm_option
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("args", "input", "expect"),
+    [
+        (["--confirm"], None, "ok"),
+        ([], "y\n", "ok"),
+        ([], "n\n", "Aborted!"),
+        ([], "\n", "Aborted!"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_confirm_option(runner, args, input, expect):
+    @click.command()
+    @confirm_option()
+    def cli():
+        click.echo("ok")
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, args, input=input)
+    assert expect in result.output
+
+
+def test_confirm_option_rejects_yes(runner):
+    @click.command()
+    @confirm_option()
+    def cli():
+        click.echo("ok")
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--yes"])
+    assert result.exit_code == 2
+    assert "No such option" in result.output
+
+
+def test_confirm_option_custom_decls(runner):
+    @click.command()
+    @confirm_option("--force", "-f", prompt="Really?")
+    def cli():
+        click.echo("ok")
+
+    assert runner.invoke(cli, ["-f"]).output == "ok\n"
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, input="n\n")
+    assert "Really?" in result.output
+    assert "Aborted!" in result.output
+
+
+def test_confirm_option_help(runner):
+    @click.command()
+    @confirm_option()
+    def cli():
+        pass
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--help"])
+    assert "--confirm" in result.output
+    assert "Confirm the action without prompting." in result.output
